i) Explain the construction and working of lithium ion batteries. Mention any two advantages of it.

ii) Give reason: Aqueous electrolytes are not preferred in lithium ion batteries.

i) Write the anodic, cathodic reactions and calculate the EMF of the following cell.

$$
\mathrm{Fe / FeSO_4\ (0.1\ M)\ ||\ PbSO_4\ (0.05\ M)\ /\ Pb\ at\ 298\ K.\ (Given\ E^\circ_{Fe}=-0.44\ V,\ E^\circ_{Pb}=-0.13\ V)}
$$

ii) Describe the construction and working of Daniel cell.

i) Oxidant must be free from traces of $\mathrm{CO_2}$ in AFC.

ii) Proper water transport management is crucial for the proton exchange membrane of the PEMFC.

i) Define Beer-Lambert's law. Write the mathematical expression of it.

ii) Explain the conductometric titration of strong acid vs strong base with illustration.

i) How galvanic series is different from EMF series?

ii) Explain the electrochemical mechanism of rusting of iron.

ii) Explain the effect of following factors on the rate of corrosion

a) Temperature

b) nature of corrosion product.

Identify and explain the type of corrosion in the below example;

Deposition of extraneous matter on the surface of iron.

Differentiate between the following (Any two points each) -

i) Number average and weight average.

ii) Thermotropic and lyotropic liquid crystal.

iii) Inter and intramolecular hydrogen bonding.

iv) Top down and bottom up approach.

i) Give reason: Nylon 6 6 has higher tensile strength than polyethylene

ii) In a polymer sample, 30 % molecules have a molecular mass 20000, 40 % have molecular mass 30000 and 30% have molecular mass of 60000. Calculate the number average and weight average molecular weight, and polydispersity index of the polymer.

Identify the matrix and dispersed phase in the following composite material.

i) Concrete mixture

ii) Kevlar

Calculate $\Delta G$, $\Delta H$ and $\Delta S$ for the cell reaction at 298 K.
